With passion, speed, and grit, we run to honor our fallen law enforcement officers.

To recognize #NationalPoliceWeek, the El Centro Sector hosted the 16th Annual Imperial Valley Law Enforcement Relay Run. This event brings together local law enforcement agencies to pay tribute to our officers who have made the ultimate sacrifice. And through friendly competition, we strengthen the bonds of the #ImperialValley law enforcement community.

#ElCentro #Calexico #PremierSector #CBP #DHS #BorderPatrol #HonorFirst #RememberTheFallen

tweets.text:
What do you get when you cross a previously convicted carjacker with a ghost gun? A FOOT PURSUIT, OF COURSE.

When you’ve just been released from a 3-year prison sentence for carjacking, you probably (definitely) shouldn’t be packing a firearm.

A #PremierSector agent saw a single CHP officer on a stop with two subjects and decided to stop and assist because teamwork makes the dream work. As our agent attempted to conduct a Terry frisk for officer safety, one subject decided he was going to test his 100-yard dash time and sprinted into an alfalfa field to get away. 

He must have thought the weapon and ammo he was carrying was invisible while he was tossing it into the field in front of our pursuing agent. Guess what? We saw it!! 👀

After taking the subject into custody, our agent turned him and his recovered ghost gun 👻🔫 back over to CHP. This felon must really miss prison cafeteria food because he’s working extra hard to go back. 

Video courtesy of David Abatti and @pinshi_metishi_760

#CBP #DHS #BorderPatrol #CHP #FelonFails

Kudos to these soldiers from the U.S. Army’s 720th Military Police Battalion. In two recent events, they spotted groups of illegal aliens, enabling our agents to apprehend both the illegal aliens and their smugglers. Even more impressive, these events occurred in parts of our area of responsibility with particularly challenging terrain.

Well done, gentlemen! We’re proud to have these premier soldiers working with us here in the #PremierSector. 

#CBP #DHS #BorderPatrol #Army #ArmyStrong
